summary: Family of four (2 adults + kids 3 & 5) · round-trip via Narita · 5 nights Tokyo + 6 Kansai + 1 Tokyo

entries.title: Land at Narita — Narita Express straight to the hotel (~75 min)
Check in, konbini dinner + a first look at the Shinjuku lights
Early night to get ahead of the jet lag before it hits the kids
Akihabara — anime deep dive: figures, retro arcades, Gundam Base, Mandarake
Brunch / lunch (a themed café if the kids are game)
Kimono photoshoot at Senso-ji
Sumida Aquarium at Tokyo Skytree — penguins & jellyfish
At the gate before the 9:00 opening — rope-drop Fantasyland. Weekday = shorter lines
Lunch + an optional hotel nap reset
Back for afternoon rides at a gentler pace
Christmas parade, then out ahead of the closing crush
teamLab Planets — first slot; calmest right at open
Lunch around Toyosu / Odaiba
Unicorn Gundam at DiverCity — Gundam Base + the 3:00 statue transformation
Optional: stay for the illuminated night show

days.title: Harajuku, Shibuya & sunset from the sky

entries.title: Harajuku — Takeshita & Omotesando: sneakers, @cosme skincare
Shibuya — 109 & Parco for clothes, the Pokémon Center
Shibuya Crossing + Hachiko — the world's busiest scramble at street level
Shibuya Sky for sunset — the view down onto the crossing

days.title: Bullet train & Gion at dusk
days.transfer: Shinkansen · Tokyo → Kyoto · ~10:00 AM · 2h15m · reserve a full row · Mt Fuji on the right ~40 min in

entries.title: Shinkansen Tokyo → Kyoto
Arrive Kyoto, drop bags at the hotel
Nishiki Market snacks + a Kamo River stroll
Gion at dusk — lantern-lit lanes as the light drops early
Kiyomizu-dera — 'early' means 8:00: buses land ~9:30, the stage jams by 10:30
Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka — the old lanes downhill before they clog
Yasaka Shrine + lunch back in Gion
Bamboo Grove — empty at 8:00, a river of people by 10:00
Tenryu-ji garden (opens 8:30) — right beside the grove
Daytime kimono shoot — rent near the Kimono Forest, shoot the riverside & Nonomiya lanes
Lunch in kimono + a relaxed riverside afternoon
Early start — fast train to Kobe + express bus over the Akashi-Kaikyo Bridge (~2–2.5h each way)
NARUTO & Boruto Shinobi-Zato — ninja trials, Ichiraku Ramen, Hokage Rock (Dad's must)
Crayon Shin-chan Adventure Park — ziplines & kid-scaled obstacle courses
Godzilla (life-size, zipline, museum) or Dragon Quest Island
Head back to Kyoto (~2.5h), home by ~7:30 PM
Train from Kyoto (~40–55 min) — a slower start after Awaji
Shinsaibashi arcade + Amerimura — sneakers, streetwear
Optional: Osaka Castle Park for the foliage
Dotonbori — Glico sign, takoyaki, Don Quijote for a tax-free skincare haul

days.title: Ten thousand gates & the deer of Nara

entries.title: Fushimi Inari at the gates — 5 min from Kyoto; beat the Saturday crowds
Stay on the same JR Nara line straight down to Nara (~45 min)
Nara Park deer — feed before they're overfed; then Todai-ji's Great Buddha
Back to Kyoto for last souvenirs

days.title: Back to Tokyo & a taste of home
days.transfer: Shinkansen · Kyoto → Tokyo · ~1:00 PM · 2h15m · looping back for the buffer night before the flight home

entries.title: Last easy Kyoto morning, relaxed checkout
Shinkansen to Tokyo (~2h15)
Check into the Tokyo hotel — one with easy Narita access
Final shopping or one more Akihabara run — Uniqlo/GU, ABC-Mart, skincare
Nigerian dinner at Esogie — jollof, egusi & a taste of home to close the trip
Unhurried — the flight's in the evening, so pack slowly and grab one last thing
Narita Express to the airport (~60 min) for the ~6:35 PM flight
